decision_note: Every required implementation and data gate passes. The historical test stays sealed until the team records GO: issue a new gate version with historical_test_status 'GO', then run historical mode with the explicit approval token. Before that, the team should settle the two open items below.

required_gates.gate: First development forecast uses exactly 48 labels, including 2019-01 with Retail Sales missing
Risk-free DTB4WK pinned, hashed and covering the test window
Risk-free series verified against FRED (all 6,258 DTB4WK observations, 2001-07-31 to 2026-10-01)
Canonical scorer formally adopted; the original scorer cannot be reproduced byte-for-byte; the canonical rerun supersedes the earlier B2/B4/B-All results
Development run reproduces the canonical summary
Frozen Black-Litterman layer and secondary portfolio metrics implemented, conventions recorded before any run, Omega frozen from A's development errors
Freeze gate 5: ETF distribution adjustment against official issuer records
Automated tests (backtest, portfolio, dividend gate; 25 tests)
Environment lockfile committed alongside the scorer
Historical test window not scored or inspected
required_gates.evidence: No 2023-02..2026-08 return, price or model output read; incidental exposures listed in stage2/results/dividend_gate/DIVIDEND_GATE_REPORT.md

open_items_before_go: Settle System C's definition (README vs frozen config) and the C/D evaluation track before opening, because opening the window for A/B reveals its outcomes before C/D are frozen.
Label 2023-01..2026-08 in all reports as partly inspected by the earlier MVP, as the audit recommended.
notes: Development portfolio results are diagnostic only: Omega is estimated from the same development errors.
Gate 5 limitation: before 2018, single IEF/LQD ex-dates can be verified only in aggregate, because the pre-2018 file has no raw prices and NAV noise exceeds a monthly distribution.
